lines.en: There are several things in life I have accepted that I will never understand.
lines.zh: 人生里有几件事，我已经接受了自己永远不会懂。

lines.en: The first of which has been explained to me many times-
lines.zh: 第一件，已经有人跟我解释过很多遍了——

lines.en: It’s the way floating dust particles manage to shimmer and glow when hit at the correct angle by light.
lines.zh: 就是飘浮的尘埃，被光以某个刚好的角度打中时，会闪烁、会发亮。

lines.en: How something invisible to the naked eye can be made visible by pure electromagnetic radiation...or something like that.
lines.zh: 肉眼看不见的东西，怎么会凭一束电磁辐射就变得可见……大概就是这么回事吧。

lines.en: I’ve retained the information. I’d be foolish not to after how many times I have heard it.
lines.zh: 这些话我都记住了。听了那么多遍还不记住，那我可就太傻了。
但我永远不会懂。

lines.en: The second thing is the romanticization of death.
lines.zh: 第二件事，是人们对死亡的浪漫化。

lines.en: And how there are people who speak of it with such fervor that it often appears to bring them more joy and curiosity than the unwrapping of presents on Christmas morning.
lines.zh: 也总有人谈起死亡时兴致高昂，那股劲头看上去比拆圣诞节的礼物还让他们欢喜、让他们好奇。
第三件事，是你。

lines.en: You’re a curious one...do you know that?
lines.zh: 你是个很奇怪的人……你自己知道吗？

lines.en: Trapped in the dark, suspended somewhere between life and death...with eyes swollen shut so dramatically that you can’t even see the dust I’ve taken the liberty of illuminating for you.
lines.zh: 困在黑暗里，悬停在生与死之间的某处……眼睛肿得紧紧闭着，连我擅自替你照亮的那粒尘埃都看不见。

lines.en: I want you to be just as confused as me, you know?
lines.zh: 我希望你也跟我一样困惑，知道吗？
这里很孤单。

lines.en: It’s lonely having no one to talk to...no one to submerge myself in uncertainties with.
lines.zh: 没有人可以说话、没有人可以陪我一起沉溺在不确定里……这种孤单，很难受。

lines.en: It’s just me, the dust, and the incessant circling of the drain that is the idea that I will, one day, no longer be able to share little thoughts like these with anyone.
lines.zh: 这里只有我、尘埃，还有一个挥之不去的念头在脑中打转——终有一天，我再也没法把这些小小的心事说给任何人听。
你喜欢诗吗？
嗯？
不？

lines.en: I’m sorry. I’m sure it’s difficult to answer a question like that in your current state.
lines.zh: 抱歉。以你现在的状态，大概很难回答这样的问题吧。

lines.en: Personally, I’ve never been a big fan of it.
lines.zh: 就我个人而言，我对诗谈不上多喜欢。

lines.en: It requires too much...interpretation. To the point where sometimes, even the clearest of thoughts have a variety of different meanings that all go on to contradict one another.
lines.zh: 它需要太多……解读。以至于有时候，再清晰的想法也会生出好几种互相矛盾的含义。
但是——

lines.en: There is one line from a very famous poet paraphrasing a very famous politician that goes something like...
lines.zh: 不过有一位很有名的诗人，转述过一位很有名的政治家的话，大意是……

lines.en: There is no beauty without some strangeness in its proportions.
lines.zh: 没有比例上的奇异，便没有美。

lines.en: And I like that line very much.
lines.zh: 我非常喜欢这句话。

lines.en: In fact, I’m sure that if you don’t already enjoy it yourself, that you’ll come to do so soon.
lines.zh: 事实上我敢肯定，就算你现在还不喜欢，很快也会喜欢的。

lines.en: Because where you’re going is somewhere special.
lines.zh: 因为你要去的地方很特别。

lines.en: Somewhere with so much strangeness in every single one of its proportions that you’ll be forced to understand how truly beautiful life can be, even during its darkest moments.
lines.zh: 一个每一处比例都透着奇异的地方——奇异到你会不得不明白，人生可以多么美，哪怕是在它最黑暗的时刻。

lines.en: Would it be a bit preemptive for me to tell you that I love you?
lines.zh: 现在就告诉你「我爱你」，是不是有点太早了？

lines.en: Not romantically, of course. We barely even know each other.
lines.zh: 当然不是恋爱那种。我们几乎都还不认识。

lines.en: But I love that you’re here.
lines.zh: 但我喜欢你在这里。

lines.en: I love that we’re here together because, like I said, I have been very...very lonely.
lines.zh: 我喜欢我们在这里相伴——就像我说的，我一直非常……非常孤单。

lines.en: I’m sure you’ll come to despise me in time.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，用不了多久你就会开始讨厌我。

lines.en: I’m sure these little conversations that I’ll force you to have with me will eat away at you like botflies.
lines.zh: 我敢肯定，我硬拉你进行的这些小对话，会像马蝇一样一点点啃噬你。

lines.en: And I’m even more sure that every one of the thoughts I share with you will get underneath your skin like the eggs those botflies lay.
lines.zh: 而我更敢肯定，我对你说的每一个念头，都会像马蝇产下的卵一样钻进你的皮肤底下。

lines.en: But it’s all for good reason, you see.
lines.zh: 但这一切都自有道理，你明白的。

lines.en: It’s because that is my job.
lines.zh: 因为，这就是我的工作。

lines.en: It’s because, for some reason even I don’t understand, I was chosen to be your personal, mysterious and anonymous narrator.
lines.zh: 因为，连我自己也不明白是为什么，我被选中做你专属的、神秘而匿名的旁白。

lines.en: Will we ever meet for real?
lines.zh: 我们有朝一日会真正见面吗？
谁知道呢？
但我希望会。
那么！

lines.en: I suppose it’s time we get down to business.
lines.zh: 我想，是时候办正事了。

lines.en: Ahh, how I have missed the daylight.
lines.zh: 啊啊，我有多想念白昼的光。

lines.en: There’s nothing quite like the feeling of sunlight soaking into your skin on a hot, summer day.
lines.zh: 没有什么比得上盛夏里阳光渗进皮肤的感觉。

lines.en: But I’ve bothered you enough already, so I won’t get the two of us sidetracked with some tangent about the weather.
lines.zh: 不过我已经打扰你够久了，就不拉着你我扯天气这种闲篇了。

lines.en: Especially since it’ll be like this for...well, you’ll see soon enough.
lines.zh: 何况，接下来很长一段时间都会是这样……嗯，你很快就知道了。

lines.en: Oh! There is one more thing I’m obligated to tell you before the game starts, though.
lines.zh: 哦！不过，在游戏开始之前，还有一件事我必须告诉你。

lines.en: You can take it seriously or not, it doesn’t matter to me. This will be your life after all- and what good is a life where you can’t even think for yourself?
lines.zh: 你当真也罢，不当真也罢，我都无所谓。毕竟这是你的人生——而一个人若连自己的想法都没有，那还算什么人生？

lines.en: Anyway, the thing I’m supposed to tell you is this...
lines.zh: 总之，我该告诉你的是……
一切都不是真实的。

lines.en: Not me...not you...not anyone you’ll meet in the journey you start today.
lines.zh: 不是我……不是你……也不是你从今天开始的旅程将要遇见的任何人。
我们都只是空气。
那么……
我们一起呼吸，如何？
会很好玩的！

lines.en: Go on! Expel your worries from the depths of your lungs and envelop yourself in happier days!
lines.zh: 来吧！把忧虑从肺腑深处统统吐出去，让自己沉浸在更快乐的日子里！

lines.en: For this world was made for you and you alone.
lines.zh: 因为这个世界是为你、也只为你而造。

lines.en: I can’t tell you who made it...and I sure as hell can’t tell you why you were special enough to be given something like this.
lines.zh: 我没法告诉你它是谁造的……更没法告诉你，为什么你特别到足以被赐予这样的东西。

lines.en: But I can tell you, and I truly do wish this from the bottom of my heart-
lines.zh: 但我可以告诉你，而且这是我发自内心真正的祝愿——

lines.en: That I hope you have fun.
lines.zh: 我希望你玩得开心。

lines.en: And if you’re ever feeling lost or lonely, all you have to do is close your eyes and I’ll be right there-
lines.zh: 要是你感到迷茫或孤单，只需要闭上眼睛，我就守在那里——

lines.en: Annoying you every step of the way.
lines.zh: 在你走的每一步，烦着你。
那么！
你准备好了吗？
是
否
还没准备好？
哦。

lines.en: I guess it wouldn’t kill us to hang out for a little while longer, then.
lines.zh: 那就再待一会儿，应该也死不了人。

lines.en: So...what kind of stuff are you into? Any hobbies?
lines.zh: 那么……你喜欢些什么？有什么爱好吗？
兴趣？……
什么都行，有吗？

lines.en: You know, if you’re going to keep me here, you should at least respond or something. Staying silent when someone is talking to you is very rude.
lines.zh: 你看，你要是想把我留在这里，好歹也该回个话什么的。别人跟你说话却一声不吭，可是很没礼貌的。

lines.en: Okay, you know what? As your one and only friend right now, I’m going to give you a little push.
lines.zh: 好吧，这样好了。作为你此刻唯一的朋友，我来轻轻推你一把。

lines.en: Not a literal push. That would be like, really bad right now. I think.
lines.zh: 不是真的推。真推的话，现在这种状况，大概，相当不妙。我觉得。

lines.en: No, the push I’m going to give you is courage.
lines.zh: 不，我要推给你的，是勇气。
你可以的。

lines.en: I know that it’s scary. Everything is scary. That’s just kind of how life works, you know?
lines.zh: 我知道这很可怕。什么都可怕。人生差不多就是这么回事，你懂的？
但我相信你。

lines.en: And I can’t imagine that ever changing.
lines.zh: 我想这永远不会变。

lines.en: We’re a lot closer than you think.
lines.zh: 我们比你以为的要亲密得多。
那么……话说到这份上——
现在准备好了吗？
是
太好了！
那么……
不再多说……

lines.en: Jump as high as you can!
lines.zh: 使出你最大的力气，跳！
能跳多远跳多远！

lines.en: Fly away, little bird! Spread those wings of yours!
lines.zh: 飞吧，小鸟！张开你的翅膀！

lines.en: For what awaits you out there is far more amazing than anything you could ever find on this rooftop!
lines.zh: 因为等着你的东西，远比这屋顶上能找到的一切都要精彩！
去吧！
去成为更好的你！

lines.en: And remember that I’ll be right here watching.
lines.zh: 记住，我就在这里看着你。

lines.en: What do I want to do?
lines.zh: 我想做什么？
跳
跳
跳
跳
跳
跳
欢迎回家。
什么？……
: ……sei？
我好像听到什么了……
: Sensei……
我能——
: Sensei！快醒醒！

lines.en: : About time! Do you have any idea how much trouble you'd get into if the principal showed up and caught you sleeping right now?
lines.zh: : 可算醒了！你知道校长要是来了、看到你睡成这样，你会有多大麻烦吗？

lines.en: : Class ended ten minutes ago. It's time to get up.
lines.zh: : 下课已经十分钟了。该起床了。
: 什么？什么课？
: 我在哪里？

lines.en: : And...what did you call me just now?
lines.zh: : 还有……你刚才叫我什么？

lines.en: : The...same thing I always call you? Sensei.
lines.zh: : 一直……都这么叫你的那个？Sensei。

lines.en: : What's going on? Did you have a bad dream or something?
lines.zh: : 怎么了？做噩梦了还是别的什么？
: 大概吧……

lines.en: : Do you want me to call the nurse or something? You seem a little flushed.
lines.zh: : 要不要我去叫保健老师？你脸色有点发红。

lines.en: : Come a little closer so I can touch your forehead and find out.
lines.zh: : 靠近一点，让我摸摸你的额头看看。

lines.en: : I'm fine...I think I just need a few minutes to collect myself or something.
lines.zh: : 我没事……我觉得我只需要几分钟，让自己缓一缓什么的。

lines.en: Excuse me for asking this so abruptly, but-
lines.zh: 原谅我突然问这么一句，但是——

lines.en: What the fuck is going on right now?
lines.zh: 现在到底他妈的怎么回事？

lines.en: Who is this girl? Or, better question, who am I?
lines.zh: 这个女孩是谁？或者说，更重要的问题是——我是谁？
为什么我什么都想不起来？……

lines.en: This classroom seems vaguely familiar, but...
lines.zh: 这间教室说熟倒也眼熟，可是……

lines.en: But it's like each time I try to piece things together, I just circle back around and give up before I'm able to get anywhere.
lines.zh: 可每次我想把线索拼起来，思绪就绕回原地，还没走到哪一步就放弃了。

lines.en: This girl should probably know something, right?
lines.zh: 这个女孩应该知道点什么，对吧？

lines.en: But...if she's my student, she'll probably only know things that a student would know. She'll have no idea who I am or...where I even live or-
lines.zh: 可是……如果她是我的学生，她知道的也无非是学生该知道的事。她不会知道我是谁，或者……我住在哪里，或者——

lines.en: Wait, where am I supposed to go after I leave here when I still have absolutely no clue where I am?
lines.zh: 等等，我连自己身在何处都一无所知，离开这里又能去哪儿？

lines.en: : Um...are you sure you're okay? You're looking a little...panicky.
lines.zh: : 那个……你确定没事吗？你看起来有点……慌。
: 我只是……有点累吧。

lines.en: : Still? Even after sleeping through the entire last period?
lines.zh: : 还累？最后一整节课你都睡过去了诶。

lines.en: : Yeah, sorry. Long night, I guess.
lines.zh: : 嗯，抱歉。大概是昨晚没睡好吧。

lines.en: : Long night? But we were together the whole time.
lines.zh: : 没睡好？可我们一直在一起啊。
: 不好意思，你说什么？
我该不会……在跟一个高中生交往吧？

lines.en: : Okay, seriously. What's going on with you? You're acting like you don't even recognize your own niece.
lines.zh: : 好啦，说正经的。你到底怎么了？搞得好像连自己侄女都不认识一样。

lines.en: Oh. So that's how it is.
lines.zh: 哦。原来是这么回事。

lines.en: Well, that is significantly less exciting. But at least I should be able to leverage that role to...try and make sense of what's going on here.
lines.zh: 嗯，这可就无聊多了。但至少，凭着这层身份，我或许能……试着弄清楚现在的状况。

lines.en: At the very least, if we're related, she'll probably know where I live.
lines.zh: 无论如何，既然我们是亲戚，她应该知道我住哪里。

lines.en: : Of course I recognize you. I'm just feeling a little out of it right now.
lines.zh: : 我当然认得你。我只是现在有点恍惚。

lines.en: : Well, do you think going home might help? Because it doesn't seem like sticking around school is helping you at all right now.
lines.zh: : 那你觉得回家会不会好点？因为现在看来，你继续待在学校似乎一点帮助都没有。

lines.en: : Yeah, but...do you think you might be able to come with me? I could probably use the help since I'm still...you know, regaining my footing and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 嗯，不过……你能跟我一起回去吗？我大概需要有人搭把手，毕竟我还……你知道的，还没站稳脚跟什么的。

lines.en: : Why would I not come with you? We literally live together.
lines.zh: : 我怎么会不跟你回去？我们可是一起住的诶。
: 哦。对。我忘了。

lines.en: Well, at least my first five minutes in what I'm assuming is some sort of...alternate reality or something have been filled almost entirely with convenient coincidences.
lines.zh: 嗯，至少在我暂且认定为某种……平行世界之类的地方，醒来的头五分钟几乎全被恰到好处的巧合填满了。

lines.en: That has to be what this is, right? Some sort of...reincarnation type thing?
lines.zh: 这肯定就是眼下的真相了吧？某种……转生之类的设定？

lines.en: Wait, doesn't this mean that I must have died, though?
lines.zh: 等等，这不就说明我已经死过一次了吗？

lines.en: Just what the hell is happening to me all of a sudden?
lines.zh: 我到底突然遭了什么？

lines.en: : How can you just forget that we've been living together for years?
lines.zh: : 我们在一起住了这么多年，你怎么能说忘就忘？

lines.en: : What's next? Are you going to tell me you've forgotten my name?
lines.zh: : 下一步呢？你该不会连我的名字都忘了吧？

lines.en: : Oh my God! You have forgotten my name, haven't you?!
lines.zh: : 天哪！你真的把我名字忘了对不对？！
: 是 Ami，Sensei！Ami！
: 抱歉。不是针对你……大概。
: 大概？！

lines.en: : To be completely honest, I'm having a hard time remembering literally anything right now. So...I'll probably be leaning on you for help for a little while.
lines.zh: : 说实话，我现在真的什么都想不起来。所以……接下来一段时间，恐怕得多依赖你帮忙了。

lines.en: : I mean...helping you is pretty much all I do in the first place, so I'm happy to do whatever you need me to.
lines.zh: : 反正……帮你就差不多是我日常的全部了，你需要我做什么，我都乐意。

lines.en: : But if your memories are really that jumbled, shouldn't we take you to a doctor or something?
lines.zh: : 不过你的记忆真乱成这样的话，是不是该带你去看医生什么的？

lines.en: : You're old, but I didn't realize you were old enough to start dealing with that dementia thingy.
lines.zh: : 你是挺老的，但我没意识到你老到开始得那种痴呆症了。

lines.en: : I'm not that old, am I?
lines.zh: : 我没那么老吧？

lines.en: This body feels mostly healthy and well put together, so I can't imagine I'm any older than my 30's.
lines.zh: 这具身体感觉基本健康、零件齐全，我想我应该不会超过三十多岁。

lines.en: : I guess not. You're actually one of the youngest teachers we have, I think.
lines.zh: : 好像也是。我想，你其实是我们老师里最年轻的几个之一。

lines.en: : But if there's something wrong with your brain, we should act now. Because if anything bad ever happened to you, I'd probably just die too.
lines.zh: : 但如果你的脑子出了问题，我们得马上行动。因为你要是有个三长两短，我大概也会死掉的。
: 那个反应……有点过头了吧。

lines.en: : Well, if your memories really are gone, you'll be finding out very soon that that's just the type of girl I am!
lines.zh: : 哼，要是你的记忆真没了，你很快就会明白，我就是这样的女孩！

lines.en: : Or you're just lying about all of this because you hate me and want to play a weird prank on me, but I'll play along either way!
lines.zh: : 又或者这一切都是你编的，因为你讨厌我，想对我玩什么奇怪的恶作剧——但不管哪种，我都会配合到底！

lines.en: : Helping you round up your memories sounds kinda fun, actually. It's like we're characters inside of a manga now or something.
lines.zh: : 帮你找回记忆什么的，听起来还挺有意思的。感觉我们现在就像漫画里的角色了之类的。
: 嗯……之类的。

lines.en: : I wonder how it'll end. Normally, all of the stuff where the main character loses his memories ends up being kinda depressing by the last volume.
lines.zh: : 真想知道结局会怎样。一般来讲，主角失忆这种故事，到最后一卷都会变得有点压抑。

lines.en: : I think there are more pressing matters at hand than figuring out how things are going to end right now.
lines.zh: : 我觉得比起现在就琢磨结局，眼前有更要紧的事。

lines.en: : Right, right. We've gotta get you back home since you can't remember where you live without me.
lines.zh: : 对对。得先把你带回家，毕竟没有我，你连自己住哪都想不起来。

lines.en: : You know, Sensei, if you want to spend more time with me, all you have to do is ask. You don't have to fake amnesia just for my attention.
lines.zh: : 你说，Sensei，你要是想多陪陪我，开口就行。不用为了吸引我的注意假装失忆哦。

lines.en: : Well, please forgive me if I continue to fake it for a little while longer.
lines.zh: : 那如果我打算再「装」一会儿，还请多多包涵。

lines.en: Because at this point, I still have no idea what I'm supposed to do...
lines.zh: 因为事到如今，我还是完全不知道自己该做什么……

lines.en: Ami spins around and I instinctively leave my desk to follow her, like it's something I've done time and time before.
lines.zh: Ami 转过身，我下意识地离开座位跟上她，仿佛这种事我已经做过无数次。
但其实并没有。
这不是我的人生。
不可能是。

lines.en: Because no one would ever look at me the way she does if this is where I'm meant to be.
lines.zh: 因为，如果这就是我命定之处，不该有人用她那种眼神看我。

lines.en: Without even knowing myself yet, I understand that much.
lines.zh: 连自己是谁都还不清楚，这一点我却明白。

lines.en: For as she pulls me through the halls of the school by my wrist, my mind ventures forth to forbidden territories-
lines.zh: 因为，当她拉着我的手腕穿过学校的走廊时，我的思绪悄悄探向了禁地——

lines.en: And it encircles itself in possibilities and fantasies I will not yet reveal to you.
lines.zh: 缠绕进种种可能与幻想之中——这些，我还不会向你揭示。

lines.en: If I did, I can't imagine you'd stay to observe me much longer.
lines.zh: 若是说了，我想你大概不会愿意再观察我多久。

lines.en: But I suppose I don't even know who you are...or who I'm even aiming these thoughts at right now.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，我连你是谁都不知道……这些念头此刻又是在对谁说呢。
或许——

lines.en: Well...perhaps they don't need to be aimed anywhere at all.
lines.zh: 嗯……或许，这些念头根本不需要对准谁。

lines.en: And perhaps I'm content with just imagining someone is there as it makes daydreaming all the less lonely.
lines.zh: 又或许，只要想象有个人在，我就心满意足了——这样胡思乱想起来，也没那么孤单。
